body.purpose: Everything read or tapped; Bangla falls through to the Bangla face.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one filled action per view; accent fill, pill in the default theme.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: rgb(var(--color-accent, 17 17 17)); color: rgb(var(--color-accent-fg, 255 255 255)); height: 44px; padding: 0 20px; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; font: 600 15px/1 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), transform 100ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: rgb(26 26 26); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgb(17 17 17); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary actions beside a primary one.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { background: #fff; color: #111; height: 44px; padding: 0 20px; border: 1px solid #d9d9d9; border-radius: 9999px; font: 500 15px/1 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 150ms, background-color 150ms; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { border-color: #707070; } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #111; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: The ui-control recipe: recessed, hairline, soft focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input { height: 40px; width: 260px; padding: 0 12px; background: #fff; color: #111; border: 1px solid #ececec; border-radius: 14px; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 2px 0 rgba(20,20,20,0.05); font: 400 14px/1 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: border-color 220ms, box-shadow 220ms; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #707070; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #707070; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(17,17,17,0.10); }

components.name: Discount Chip
components.css: .ds-chip-sale { display: inline-block; background: #fdecea; color: #c62828; padding: 2px 10px; border-radius: 9999px; font: 600 12px/1.5 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Product Card
components.description: White card on the soft canvas, resting shadow, lifts on hover.
components.css: .ds-card { width: 180px; background: #fff; border-radius: 20px; padding: 10px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgba(20,20,20,0.06); transition: transform 220ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), box-shadow 220ms; } .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 4px 12px -2px rgba(20,20,20,0.08), 0 2px 4px -2px rgba(20,20,20,0.04); } .ds-card-media { aspect-ratio: 1 / 1; background: #f5f5f5; border-radius: 14px; } .ds-card-title { margin: 10px 4px 2px; font: 500 14px/1.3 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #111; } .ds-card-price { margin: 0 4px; font: 600 14px/1.3 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #111; } .ds-card-price s { color: #707070; font-weight: 400; }

narrative.overview: One careful shop sits behind three different shopfronts. Asif Zone, Nasihamart and Tahafi share every behaviour and differ only in the face they show, all carried by tokens. The mood is clean, trustworthy and premium; components are restrained and smooth.
keyCharacteristics: Three brand themes over one behaviour; brand-only looks live in tokens, never in `if (brand === …)`.
Phone-first at 375px for shoppers and staff alike.
Neutral surfaces, one action colour per brand, sale red only for promotions.
Two-layer elevation, soft-editorial radii, gentle ease-out motion.
English on the site, Bangla on ad landing pages — one language per page.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Each brand has one action colour. A second accent is not added; old `brass` classes are aliased to ink.

rules.name: The Promotions-Only Red Rule
rules.body: Sale colours mark promotions and nothing else.

rules.name: The Role-Not-Hex Rule
rules.body: Components use roles (`fg`, `fg-muted`, `surface`, `line`, `accent`), never raw hex, so a theme change reaches them.

rules.name: The Balanced Title Rule
rules.body: Headings use `text-wrap: balance`; no single word on a title's last line.

rules.name: The One Language Rule
rules.body: A page is English or Bangla, never both.

rules.name: The Lifted-Not-Blurred Rule
rules.body: Depth comes from two layers, never one big blur.

dos: Do build with roles and recipes (`fg`, `surface`, `accent`, `ui-control`, `ui-card-frame`) so all three themes follow.
Do put a brand-only look in that theme's tokens and keep Asif Zone's look unchanged unless the change is meant for it.
Do keep tap targets at least 24px (44px where `docs/DESIGN_SYSTEM.md` asks); use `tap-target` for isolated inline actions.
Do handle loading, empty and error states on every screen.
Do keep reading text to about 65ch.
donts: Don't use purple/blue gradients, emoji as icons, everything centred, identical three-card grids, generic hero copy or gratuitous glassmorphism.
Don't hard-code colours, fonts or one-off styles; propose a token instead.
Don't add dark mode to the admin.
Don't use sale red for anything but promotions, or a second accent colour in a brand.
Don't mix English and Bangla on one page.
